title: Topology, Morphology, Silhouette, Appendage & Modular Anatomy Authoring
objective: Implement the topology-aware component and parameter authoring kernel for humanoid/biped, quadruped, serpentine, winged, multi-limbed, aquatic, composite, constructed/modular and extensible body families, including proportion/silhouette controls and eligible appendage/modular-part authoring with explicit compatibility and anchor validation.

scope.purpose: Provide topology-first appearance authoring over owner-supplied body/anatomy truth without becoming a second Character, Species, Form, Creature or mechanics authority.
included: tails, wings, fins, extra limbs, tentacles and modular-part presentation authoring
scope.completion_gate: Representative nonhumanoid-first body families and appendage/modular-part configurations can be authored and validated deterministically as presentation proposals, with incompatible/unsupported/unresolved topology reported explicitly and no canonical anatomy, mechanics, equipment, relationship or live-state mutation.

selection_boundaries: MCCS-01 completed_verified the creator workspace/renderer-neutral draft-rebase foundation before the DAG-authorized MNCS rotation.
MCCS-01 explicitly left MCCS-03 as the next surviving MCCS-local tranche while product-development rotated through MNCS-01..24.
MNCS-24 is now completed_verified and no post-MNCS rotation overrides the interrupted MCCS sequence, so MCCS-03 is the lawful return point.
Character/NPC/Creature plus Species/Form/PPIA retain canonical identity, topology eligibility, Form/state, mechanics and live-entity truth.
CAPP/PPIA retain renderer-neutral appearance authority; MCCS supplies creator draft/authoring UX and renderer/output adapters.
PAPT/PCA retain generic asset, rig, garment, motion, image/sprite, style-generation and local-production primitives.
MCCS is topology-first rather than humanoid-first; unsupported or unresolved anatomy stays explicit instead of being fabricated into humanoid compatibility.
MCCS-03 absorbs historical MCCS-03, MCCS-04 and MCCS-08.
MCCS-03 is selected_not_started only; no implementation branch or authority exists until a later owner Continue.
The independent ui-implementation lane remains UISR-10 in_progress and player-species remains MVPS-07 in_progress; both are preserved unchanged.
next_action: Wait for the next owner Continue in the product-development lane. On that command, governed-start MCCS-03 with the OPS3 execution guard; do not implement while selected_not_started.

stop_reason.evidence: MCCS-03 is selected_not_started after terminal MNCS-24 reconciliation restored the interrupted MCCS sequence; no bounded MCCS-03 execution is active.
